title: Delta 132900 Monitor 13 Series Shower Faucet (Rough-In and Trim Included)

comparisons.notes: Delta Classic/Monitor 13 Series 132900 chrome shower, valve included
Same Delta 132900 chrome shower faucet with valve

writeup: Delta's Monitor 13 Series 132900 is a chrome, single-handle, shower-only faucet with a pressure-balancing valve, and the rough-in valve and trim are both included. It comes with knob and lever handle options. Home Depot and Lowe's both sell it for $89.
